text:
Sam: quick sync — canary on fp8-int8 hybrid exposed a low-frequency token drop for the docs model. want a compact decision DSL + emergency fallback.
Ivy: saw that pattern. short threads sometimes hide it. which signals should flip the immediate rollback?
Diego: safety signals (toxic/hallucination probes) -> immediate. quality signals -> weighted. distribution shifts (top tokens) -> advisory unless paired with quality.
Nadia: request: make token-top-100 delta an explicit secondary check; include both absolute and KL for different failure modes.
Sam: proposal: single canary_pass boolean computed by DSL. DSL example:
rollout_checks:
  immediate: [safety_any]
  weighted: [{name: degscore, weight: 3}, {name: task_f1, weight: 2}]
  advisory: [token_top100_abs, token_top100_kl]
verdict: fail if immediate OR weighted_score > threshold
Ivy: +1 but add per-model sensitivity multiplier. some models spike on quant. make thresholds overridable per customer.
Diego: also add pre-canary calibration step: if calibration reduces token delta by >40% skip canary fail. add that into DSL as `precalibrate: true`.
Nadia: ops: ensure canary emits metrics blob and human-readable explanation for why canary_pass=false. auditors need the exact rule hit.
ops-bot: canary job 2799990000 started by @Sam. collecting degscore, task_f1, token_top100_abs, token_top100_kl, safety_any, latency_p50. will post summary on completion.
Sam: owners: Diego (DSL impl), Ivy (policy config + per-customer overrides), Nadia (monitoring + audit), ops-bot will wire alerts. Diego: can you sketch the PR?
Diego: will open PR tomorrow with unit tests for token-top-100 and a small evaluator harness.
Sam: thanks — aim to land before next deploy window.
